summary: Full backend+frontend verification of new Monte Carlo v1 feature plus 8-tab regression. Backend: 6/6 pytest checks pass on POST /api/montecarlo job+poll flow against the live public URL. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright run through the Monte Carlo tab succeeds with 0 console errors. All 7 review-request bullets PASS.

verified_checklist.post_montecarlo_starts_job_and_get_polls: PASS — POST returns {job_id, status:'running'}; GET eventually returns status:'done' with result containing years[], n_trials, mean_return, liquid_start, with_conversions{success, percentiles{p10..p90}, ending{p10,p50,p90,depleted,depleted_pct,pct_positive}, histogram{counts,edges}}, without_conversions{...}. No raw trial array leaked (asserted 'trials'/'paths'/'all_paths'/'raw' absent).
verified_checklist.success_equals_one_minus_depleted_pct: PASS — for both with_ and without_conversions, |success - (1 - depleted_pct)| <= 0.001 (rounding noise only) at n_trials=400, vol=0.15, seed=11.
verified_checklist.higher_volatility_lowers_success: PASS — vol=0.12 success=0.92 vs vol=0.22 success=0.59 (paired seed=42, n=400). UI repro: vol=0.12 → 93% / vol=0.20 → 64%.
verified_checklist.fixed_seed_reproducibility: PASS — two POSTs with seed=2026, n=300, vol=0.18 produced byte-identical success, ending.p50 and percentiles.p50 arrays.
verified_checklist.frontend_controls_and_empty_state: PASS — [data-testid=tab-montecarlo] visible; clicking opens [mc-controls] with [mc-trials] select, [mc-volatility] input, [mc-run] button, and [mc-empty] before first run.
verified_checklist.frontend_results_render_after_run: PASS — after [mc-run] click all four cards appear: [mc-gauge-card] with [mc-gauge-value]='93%', [mc-compare-card] with [mc-delta]='Roth conversions change the success rate by +3.8 pts (89.0% → 92.8%).', [mc-fan-card] (median+P10–P90 band), [mc-hist-card] (note: '36 of 500 trials (7.2%) deplete to $0').
verified_checklist.gauge_equals_100_minus_depleted: PASS — gauge=93% vs 100-depleted_pct=92.8% (gauge is integer-rounded, diff=0.2pt as expected). At vol=0.20: gauge=64% vs 100-35.6=64.4% (diff=0.4pt, within integer-rounding tolerance).
verified_checklist.ui_volatility_change_lowers_success_no_c: PASS — re-running with vol=0.20 dropped success 93% -> 64%. 0 console errors and 0 page errors during the full flow.
verified_checklist.regression_8_tabs: PASS — all 8 tabs (optimizer, projection, cashflow, analytics, montecarlo, inputs, scenarios, compare) reach data-state=active on click. Optimizer still has [pull-from-plan] + 'Tax Year' label. Detail/Cashflow still has [export-full-plan]. Compare still has [compare-selectors].

critical_code_review_comments: server.py MC_JOBS is an in-process dict: ok for single-worker dev preview, but it will not survive a backend restart and is not shared across workers. Acceptable for v1, but a future enhancement should persist jobs in Mongo (a 'mc_jobs' collection keyed by job_id, with TTL index).

server.py trims MC_JOBS to last 50 by slicing 'list(MC_JOBS.keys())[:-50]'. With Python dicts insertion-ordered, this trims the OLDEST when len>50, which is correct, but the bound (50) is silent and there are no metrics. Minor.

montecarlo.py uses np.percentile per axis but with default linear interpolation — that's fine. The success metric is the path-wide 'ever depleted', which is more conservative than 'ending<=0' (both happen to coincide because depleted paths are locked at 0); the code returns both 'success' and 'success_funded' as the same value — consider removing the duplicate field or computing 'success_funded' independently from cashflow shortfalls so the two metrics can diverge meaningfully in a future version.

MonteCarlo.jsx fan-chart legend reads 'P10–P90 outcome band' but the band area is built from a transparent p10 stack + spread; ensure the legend (in MonteCarloCharts.jsx) doesn't accidentally show the helper invisible series — out of scope for this run, just a polish flag.

api.js runMonteCarlo polls every 700ms for 60 iterations (~42s). Backend is <1s for n_trials<=1000; this is plenty, but consider exponential backoff so the first poll fires after ~200ms for a snappier UX.

MonteCarlo.jsx gauge displays integer % while the delta text shows 1 decimal — visible 0.2pt discrepancy between gauge and 'with conversions' value in delta. Consider showing 1 decimal in the gauge (e.g., '92.8%') for consistency with the comparison numbers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all review-request UI checks pass; 0 console errors)

seed_data_creation: None — uses GET /api/defaults as the config payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monte Carlo v1 is fully wired end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/montecarlo {config, n_trials(250/500/1000), volatility, mean_return?, seed?} -> {job_id,'running'}; GET /api/montecarlo/{job_id} -> {status,result,error}. MC_JOBS is in-memory dict in server.py (trimmed to 50). Worker uses asyncio.to_thread(run_montecarlo,...). run_montecarlo() in montecarlo.py runs run_projection twice (with+without conversions, paired draws using identical g matrix for fair comparison), marches L_{t+1}=L_t*g+net_flow on liquid-tax-types only (Cash, Taxable, Tax-Deferred, Tax-Free), locks depleted paths at 0, returns percentiles {p10,p25,p50,p75,p90}, ending {p10,p50,p90,mean,min,pct_positive,depleted,depleted_pct} and 20-bin histogram clipped at P90. Frontend MonteCarlo.jsx polls via lib/api.js runMonteCarlo (700ms x 60). The tab bar now has 8 tabs in order: optimizer, projection, cashflow, analytics, montecarlo, inputs, scenarios, compare. Test report XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/montecarlo_results.xml.
